parent_objective: design quota-calibrated source-balanced temporal wave after M725 selected-pair cap blockage

public_gates: M727 identifies the quota caps that blocked M725
M727 defines calibrated caps that can reach the registered selected-pair target
M727 keeps action and outcome gates separate
M727 preserves sentinel and source-balance checks
actor update PPO and promotion remain blocked
forbidden_shortcuts: do not lower thresholds after seeing M727 implementation output
do not treat action-only temporal rows as outcome proof
do not change actor input contract

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: turns the M726 quota-overconstraint audit into a calibrated rerun plan
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: design only; no new data wave result and no checkpoint claim
stop_condition: stop if the design cannot preserve source-balance and sentinel checks
stop if the design would mix action-only and outcome evidence
stop if the design requires actor update PPO or promotion
stop if quota calibration would only optimize fixed public proof rows
fallback_plan: if quota calibration is insufficient, design sequence-level interventions
if source-balanced temporal rows stay outcome-neutral, design boundary mining or dynamics fidelity
if proposal coverage becomes the blocker, refresh the extreme fault scenario family
workflow_synthesis.synthesis_trigger: M726 continues the fresh source-balanced temporal wave branch after quota overconstraint audit

hypothesis: M725 source_balance_blocked can be addressed by calibrating selection quotas rather than changing the actor or training objective.
success_criteria: M727 documents the exact M725 quota overconstraint
M727 defines calibrated source-balance thresholds and run command
M727 keeps source-balance pass separate from outcome proof
M727 blocks source export actor update PPO and promotion
M727 admits only a no-training M728 implementation
failure_criteria: design treats M725 action rows as closed-loop outcome proof
design removes source-balance checks to force a pass
design admits PPO or checkpoint promotion
decision_rule: M727 may only design a no-training quota-calibrated M728 wave. It must not admit boundary mining source export PPO or promotion until M728 is run and audited.
